ilse_varga.who: Ilse Varga, a human woman fighter
ilse_varga.windup: the greatsword drawn from her back and raised high over her head in both hands, blade pointing back, back arched, knees bent, weight on the back foot
ilse_varga.strike: the greatsword chopped down and forward to waist height in front of her, blade pointing forward at the enemy, arms extended, torso leaning into the blow, front knee bent in a lunge; the scabbard on her back is empty

tamsin_tealeaf.who: Tamsin Tealeaf, a small halfling man rogue
tamsin_tealeaf.windup: the shortsword drawn and pulled back low beside his hip, crouched low and coiled, the free hand reaching forward for balance
tamsin_tealeaf.strike: lunging forward in a deep low stab, the shortsword thrust straight out at full arm's length toward the enemy, back leg straight

hedda_ironvow.who: Hedda Ironvow, a stout dwarf woman cleric
hedda_ironvow.windup: the flanged mace raised high above her head in the right hand, the round shield held up in front of her body, feet planted wide
hedda_ironvow.strike: the mace smashed down and forward in front of her at chest height, the shield swept aside, leaning hard into the blow

silvain_aster.who: Silvain Aster, a high elf wizard
silvain_aster.windup: the quarterstaff raised high in the right hand, the left hand pulled back beside the hip with fingers curled around a small pale-blue flame, torso leaning back
silvain_aster.strike: the left arm thrust straight out toward the enemy at shoulder height with the palm open and a small burst of pale-blue flame leaving it, the staff swept forward too, robes swinging, leaning onto the front foot

ismark.who: Ismark Kolyanovich, a tall young human nobleman
ismark.windup: the longsword drawn and raised high over his right shoulder in both hands, body twisted back, feet apart
ismark.strike: the longsword slashed down and across in front of him, blade pointing forward and down at the enemy, arms extended, leaning into the cut, front knee bent

ireena.who: Ireena Kolyana, a young human noblewoman
ireena.windup: a slim dagger drawn and pulled back beside her shoulder, the other hand raised in front of her, cloak swinging, weight on the back foot
ireena.strike: lunging forward, the dagger thrust straight out at full arm's length toward the enemy, cloak flaring behind her

rose.windup: drawn back and hunched, both hands raised beside her face with fingers curled like claws, mouth open in a wail, hair lifting
rose.strike: lunging forward with both arms reaching straight out toward the enemy, fingers spread, hair and dress streaming back

thorn.windup: drawn back and hunched, both hands raised beside his face with fingers curled like claws, mouth open in a wail
thorn.strike: lunging forward with both arms reaching straight out toward the enemy, fingers spread, hair and jacket streaming back

donavich.who: Father Donavich, an old human priest
donavich.windup: the wooden sunburst holy symbol lifted high above his head in the right hand, the left hand on his chest, head thrown back
donavich.strike: the holy symbol thrust straight out at arm's length toward the enemy, a small burst of candle-orange light at it, leaning forward with a fierce look

father_lucian.who: Father Lucian Petrovich, a human priest
father_lucian.windup: the brass sunburst holy symbol lifted high above his head in the right hand, the left hand open at his chest, looking up
father_lucian.strike: the holy symbol thrust straight out at arm's length toward the enemy, a small burst of candle-orange light at it, leaning forward, stole swinging

bildrath.who: Bildrath Cantemir, a burly human shopkeeper
bildrath.windup: the right fist drawn far back beside his ear, the left arm forward, shoulders hunched, scowling
bildrath.strike: a big right punch thrown straight out at full arm's length toward the enemy, body turned into it, leaning forward

parriwimple.who: Parriwimple, a very tall, lanky young human man
parriwimple.windup: both big fists clasped together and raised high over his head, back arched, looking worried
parriwimple.strike: both clasped fists brought down hard in front of him at waist height toward the enemy, bent forward at the waist, knees bent

mad_mary.who: Mad Mary, a distraught human woman
mad_mary.windup: both hands raised beside her head with fingers hooked like claws, shoulders hunched, wild hair flying
mad_mary.strike: lunging forward with both arms raking out at the enemy, fingers clawed, shawl flying

morgantha.who: Morgantha, a stooped old woman who is secretly a night hag
morgantha.windup: the basket dropped to her side, the free hand raised high with long hooked black claws, a cruel grin
morgantha.strike: the clawed hand raked down and forward across the enemy at full arm's length, leaning far forward, teeth bared

strahd.who: Strahd von Zarovich, a tall vampire nobleman
strahd.windup: the right hand raised high with fingers curled into claws, the cape swept open behind him, fangs bared, leaning back
strahd.strike: lunging forward with the clawed right hand raking out at full arm's length toward the enemy, the cape flaring behind him, fangs bared

ghoul.windup: rearing back with both clawed hands raised high above its head, jaws open, tongue lolling
ghoul.strike: lunging forward low with both claws raking down and forward at the enemy, jaws wide open

ghast.windup: rearing back with both clawed hands raised high above its head, jaws open, coat tails swinging
ghast.strike: lunging forward low with both claws raking down and forward at the enemy, jaws wide open

specter.who: a specter, all pale frost-blue and moonlit blue in every frame (shroud, hands and face; no purple, grey or tan)
specter.windup: drawn back and rising, both long thin hands pulled back beside its face, shroud billowing, mouth open in a wail
specter.strike: surging forward with both hands thrust straight out at the enemy, fingers spread, shroud streaming back

shadow.windup: rearing back with one clawed hand raised high above its head, the other forward, body stretched tall
shadow.strike: lunging forward low with the clawed hand slashing down and forward at the enemy at full reach

cultist.windup: the curved ritual dagger drawn and raised high above the hooded head in the right hand, robe swinging
cultist.strike: the curved dagger slashed down and forward at the enemy at full arm's length, leaning into the cut, front knee bent

animated_armor.windup: the right armoured fist drawn far back beside the helm, the left arm forward, torso twisted
animated_armor.strike: the right gauntlet punched straight out at full arm's length toward the enemy, leaning forward, front knee bent

animated_flying_sword.windup: the sword tilted far back, point raised up and back over the hilt, as if drawn back for a cut
animated_flying_sword.strike: the sword swung forward and down, blade nearly level and pointing forward at the enemy, the hilt trailing

broom_of_animated_attack.windup: the broom reared back on its bristles, the handle tilted far back, bristle head raised high
broom_of_animated_attack.strike: the broom bent sharply forward, the bristle head slammed down and forward at the enemy, the handle tilted forward

grick.windup: rearing up higher and drawing back, the four barbed tentacles spread wide open, the beak gaping
grick.strike: lunging forward low, the beak snapping shut out in front, the four tentacles lashing forward at the enemy

shambling_mound.windup: rearing back with both thick arm-masses raised high above it, vines dripping
shambling_mound.strike: both arm-masses slammed down and forward onto the ground in front of it at the enemy, the whole heap lurching forward

swarm_of_rats.windup: the heap bunched up and drawn back, rats rearing on their hind legs with mouths open
swarm_of_rats.strike: the heap surging forward, the front rats leaping toward the enemy with mouths wide open, tails whipping

vampire_spawn.windup: rearing back with the right clawed hand raised high, the left clawed hand forward, fangs bared
vampire_spawn.strike: lunging forward low with the right claw raking down and forward at the enemy at full reach, fangs bared

strahd_zombie.windup: the right rotting hand raised high above the helmet with fingers clawed, stiff and upright
strahd_zombie.strike: the clawed hand swung down and forward at the enemy at full arm's length, leaning forward stiffly

zombie.windup: both arms raised high above its head, hands clasped into a club, jaw hanging open
zombie.strike: both arms clubbed down hard in front of it at chest height toward the enemy, bent forward at the waist

wolf.windup: crouched low and coiled to spring, head lowered, hackles raised, lips drawn back in a snarl, weight on the hind legs
wolf.strike: lunging forward, body stretched out, front paws reaching forward off the ground, head thrust forward with jaws wide open

dire_wolf.windup: crouched low and coiled to spring, head lowered, hackles raised, lips drawn back in a snarl, weight on the hind legs
dire_wolf.strike: lunging forward, body stretched out, front paws reaching forward off the ground, head thrust forward with jaws wide open

commoner.windup: a short wooden club raised high over her right shoulder in both hands, shawl swinging
commoner.strike: the club swung down and forward at the enemy at full arm's length, leaning into the blow

villager.windup: a short wooden club raised high over his right shoulder in both hands, body twisted back
villager.strike: the club swung down and forward at the enemy at full arm's length, leaning into the blow, front knee bent

noble.windup: the slim rapier drawn and held back at shoulder height pointing forward, the free hand raised behind him, in a fencer's crouch
noble.strike: a deep fencer's lunge, the rapier thrust straight out at full arm's length toward the enemy, front knee bent, back leg straight, cape flaring

madam_eva.who: Madam Eva, an ancient Vistani fortune-teller
madam_eva.windup: both hands raised high above her head with fingers spread and bangles sliding down, shawls lifting, eyes wide
madam_eva.strike: one bony finger jabbed straight out at the enemy at full arm's length, the other hand at her chest, leaning forward, a small spark of lilac light at the fingertip

baron_vargas.who: Baron Vargas Vallakovich, a portly burgomaster
baron_vargas.windup: a slim ceremonial sword drawn and raised high over his right shoulder, belly thrust out, red-faced and furious
baron_vargas.strike: the sword slashed down and forward at the enemy at full arm's length, leaning into the cut, coat tails flying

izek.who: Izek Strazni, a hulking human man with a monstrous fiendish right arm
izek.windup: the huge fiendish right arm drawn far back and raised high with the black claws spread, teeth gritted
izek.strike: the fiendish arm smashed down and forward at the enemy at full reach, claws first, leaning hard into the blow

lady_wachter.who: Lady Fiona Wachter, a stern aristocratic widow
lady_wachter.windup: a slim dagger drawn from her sleeve and raised beside her shoulder, the other hand clutching her shawl, cold glare
lady_wachter.strike: the dagger stabbed straight out at full arm's length toward the enemy, leaning forward, skirts swinging

rictavio.windup: a slim rapier drawn and held back at shoulder height pointing forward, the free hand raised behind him, coat tails swinging
rictavio.strike: a deep fencer's lunge, the rapier thrust straight out at full arm's length toward the enemy, front knee bent, coat tails flaring

blinsky.windup: a wooden toymaker's mallet raised high over his head in both hands, jester's cap flopping, manic grin
blinsky.strike: the mallet swung down hard in front of him at the enemy, bent forward, cap bells flying

urwin_martikov.windup: a heavy wooden cudgel raised high over his right shoulder, the left arm forward, feet planted
urwin_martikov.strike: the cudgel swung down and forward at the enemy at full arm's length, leaning into the blow, apron swinging

danika_martikov.windup: a short wooden cudgel raised high over her right shoulder, the left arm forward, determined look
danika_martikov.strike: the cudgel swung down and forward at the enemy at full arm's length, leaning into the blow

arrigal.windup: the curved dagger drawn from his sash and held back low beside his hip, crouched, coat swinging
arrigal.strike: the curved dagger slashed up and forward across the enemy at full arm's length, lunging forward, coat flaring

victor_vallakovich.who: Victor Vallakovich, a teenage boy wizard
victor_vallakovich.windup: the spellbook held open in the left hand, the right hand pulled back beside his face with fingers curled around a small lilac spark
victor_vallakovich.strike: the right arm thrust straight out toward the enemy with the palm open and a small burst of lilac light leaving it, the open book held up, robe swinging

lydia_petrovna.who: Lady Lydia Petrovna, a plump, cheerful noblewoman
lydia_petrovna.windup: the right hand raised high beside her head, open palm, the fixed smile turned furious
lydia_petrovna.strike: the open right hand slapped forward and across at the enemy at full arm's length, leaning forward, curls bouncing

vallaki_guard.windup: the spear lowered level in both hands and pulled back, the point aimed forward at the enemy, crouched, weight on the back foot
vallaki_guard.strike: lunging forward, the spear thrust straight out in both hands at full reach toward the enemy, front knee bent, back leg straight

vistana.windup: the knife drawn from her sash and held back low beside her hip, crouched, skirts swinging
vistana.strike: the knife slashed up and forward across the enemy at full arm's length, lunging forward, skirts and shawl flaring

arabelle.windup: a small stone held in the right hand drawn far back behind her shoulder, the left arm pointing forward, weight on the back foot
arabelle.strike: the right arm flung forward at full stretch, the stone just leaving her hand toward the enemy, leaning forward, skirt swinging

bluto.who: Bluto Krogarov, a gaunt, half-mad fisherman
bluto.windup: the empty bottle raised high over his head by its neck, the net slipping from his shoulder, wild-eyed
bluto.strike: the bottle swung down and forward at the enemy at full arm's length, lurching forward, coat flapping

gunther_arasek.who: Gunther Arasek, a burly stockyard trader
gunther_arasek.windup: the right fist drawn far back beside his ear, the left arm forward, shoulders hunched, jaw set
gunther_arasek.strike: a big right punch thrown straight out at full arm's length toward the enemy, body turned into it, leaning forward

henrik.who: Henrik van der Voort, a frightened coffin maker
henrik.windup: a carpenter's hammer raised high over his head in a shaking right hand, eyes squeezed half shut
henrik.strike: the hammer swung down and forward at the enemy at full arm's length, stumbling forward, holy symbols swinging

kasimir_velikov.who: Kasimir Velikov, a dusk elf mage
kasimir_velikov.windup: the right hand pulled back beside his shoulder with fingers curled around a small lilac flame, the left hand raised in front of him, coat swinging
kasimir_velikov.strike: the right arm thrust straight out toward the enemy with the palm open and a small burst of lilac flame leaving it, leaning onto the front foot, coat flaring

luvash.windup: one wine bottle raised high over his head in the right hand, the other bottle held out in front, roaring
luvash.strike: the raised bottle smashed down and forward at the enemy at full arm's length, lunging forward, sash swinging

milivoj.windup: the long-handled spade raised high over his right shoulder in both hands like an axe, body twisted back, scowling
milivoj.strike: the spade swung down and forward in both hands at the enemy, blade first, leaning into the blow, front knee bent

stanimir.who: Stanimir, a huge, jovial Vistani elder
stanimir.windup: a curved scimitar drawn from his sash and raised high over his right shoulder, the fiddle tucked under the other arm
stanimir.strike: the scimitar slashed down and across at the enemy at full arm's length, lunging forward, sleeves billowing
